scope: Dated primary-provider and regulatory route recheck. It maps possible future authorized data-delivery categories without applying for data, accepting a delivery, inspecting credentials, selecting an instrument, calculating a result, or authorizing an external action.

route_matrix.what_is_proven: The retained authorization statement says that receiving, using or operating SSE/SZSE market information requires permission from their authorized information operators. The retained product description lists historical snapshots, transactions, daily/minute bars, auction data, security basic information and ETF IOPV as historical product categories and provides an application route.
what_is_not_proven: A current license, delivery, lawful internal-research/replay/derivation right or an accepted entitlement
Point-in-time universe, delisting/status history, corporate-action or investor-total-return ledger
published_at/available_at, revision/version, raw-object or field-dictionary coverage for a delivered history
Broker-specific cost, order state, no-fill/partial-fill or settlement evidence

route_matrix.what_is_proven: Only that official CFFEX historical-data and application-material URLs were identified as possible future diligence leads. The case-local capture returned connection errors and retained no CFFEX source object.
what_is_not_proven: Any historical field, contract-master, delivery-state, margin, position-limit, revision, license or entitlement coverage
Two-sided quotes, legging/no-fill treatment, broker/FCM costs, settlement or personal product eligibility

route_matrix.what_is_proven: The retained CSRC rule covers public disclosure of NAV, cumulative NAV, reports, material events and distribution matters.
what_is_not_proven: A complete point-in-time fund/share-class universe and status history
A standardized investor-total-return, actual cash-flow, fee, tax, settlement or execution ledger
Historical availability/version chain and written replay/derived-analysis rights

route_matrix.what_is_proven: No current authorized record is present in this environment.
what_is_not_proven: Account/product eligibility, costs, margins, order acceptance/rejection, partial fills, no fills, settlement and tax treatment

required_composite_acceptance_package: Written provider entitlement covering retention, replay, derived analysis and independent review for the exact research use.
Point-in-time investable universe and status history, including inactive, renamed, suspended, risk-warning and delisted instruments where relevant.
Complete cash-flow, corporate-action, distribution, rights, merger, delisting and restatement treatment with a documented return convention.
published_at, available_at, revision/version, raw-object hash and field dictionary for every historical decision and outcome input.
Decision-time quote/depth/status/limit/no-fill and cost/tax/settlement records, or a separately accepted conservative no-fill protocol.
For futures, an actual-contract master plus final-trading-day, delivery-state, dynamic margin, position-limit and risk-control records for each leg.
An independent source-governance acceptance before any new protocol is frozen.

decision.why: The official materials make a conditional future authorized-data route more concrete, but they do not provide an existing written right, historical delivery, field acceptance or execution record. C48 therefore remains unchanged.
decision.only_next_path: If the user expressly authorizes review of a particular licensed delivery, source governance must first accept its written rights, field dictionary, coverage, point-in-time/version provenance and execution complement. No new strategy protocol may be frozen before that acceptance.

boundary: C49 does not request procurement, infer an entitlement from a public page, select an asset, calculate a return, assert a stable outcome, or authorize an external action.
